subject.title: feat(ios): Talk camera flip control and mic input selection

question: Should an agent camera request that omits `facing` remain a universal front-camera request, or should omission be preserved so iOS may apply the Talk-selected default while explicit `facing` and `deviceId` continue to win?
rationale: The present iOS-only fallback cannot implement the advertised agent behavior because the core nodes tool has already materialized the front-camera default; changing that defaulting boundary affects a documented cross-device command contract.

options.title: Resolve omitted facing at the target
options.body: Preserve a truly omitted `facing` through the node command so iOS can apply the user-selected default while explicit agent requests remain authoritative.

options.title: Keep universal front default
options.body: Retain the existing core front-camera default and narrow or remove the Talk flip feature so it does not promise control over agent-originated captures.

recommendation.title: Resolve omitted facing at the target
recommendation.body: Preserve a truly omitted `facing` through the node command so iOS can apply the user-selected default while explicit agent requests remain authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: The current contributor owns the proposed iOS behavior and can route the cross-boundary decision to the relevant node-command owner.
